subject: Function identity: name, length and Function.prototype.toString
approach: native.nativeFunction builds a real Node-API function that forwards to the JavaScript implementation; no Function.prototype.toString hook is involved

residual.detail: napi_create_function always adds them as non-configurable data properties; Chrome exposes them only as poisoned accessors on Function.prototype

residual.item: prototype own property on methods and accessors
residual.detail: Chrome methods have no prototype; the Node-API property is non-configurable so it cannot be removed
Chrome reports EventTarget; this project has no EventTarget interface
